description: Test suite for VoiceWakeManager's extractCommand method, including helper functions to generate test segments and various unit tests to verify behavior with different trigger scenarios.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManagerExtractCommandTests
classes.description: Test suite containing multiple test cases for the extractCommand method.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNoTriggerFound
methods.description: Tests that extractCommand returns nil when no trigger word is present in the transcript.

methods.name: extractCommandTrimsTokensAndResult
methods.description: Tests that extractCommand trims whitespace and correctly extracts the command following the trigger.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenGapTooShort
methods.description: Verifies that extractCommand returns nil if the post-trigger gap is shorter than the minimum required.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNothingAfterTrigger
methods.description: Ensures extractCommand returns nil when there are no words after the trigger.

methods.name: extractCommandIgnoresEmptyTriggers
methods.description: Checks that empty or whitespace-only triggers are ignored in the extraction process.

methods.name: makeSegments
methods.description: Creates WakeWordSegment objects from provided words, start times, and durations, to simulate test segments.
